About this space
Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place. Perfect gate away for quick business trip or a weekend away. This unit is located in the quiet leafy Surbubs close to the city Center . It is ideally located across the road from 2 great restaurants, shops and amenities are less than a 5 minutes drive away.With modern finishes and thoughtful amenities guest comfort is our top priority.

The space
This unit is ideally located next to great restaurants. And it is just 800m away from the city.

Guest access
Guests have access to a cool leafy garden ideal for those hot summer nights

Other things to note
There are three other units on the property but each separate from the others, each with their own private garden and designated parking spots
